sources.title: The Geologic Enhanced Mapping System (GEMS) Prize Challenge — problem description
claims_verified: Metric: distance-weighted Tversky index, DTI = TPw/(TPw + alpha*FPw + beta*FNw) with alpha=0.2, beta=0.8 and a linear triangular kernel k(d)=max(1-d/300 m,0).

TPw = sum_g max_{x: d(x,g)<=R} p(x)k(d); FPw = sum_{x: p(x)>0} p(x)[1 - max_g k(d(x,g))]; FNw = sum_g [1 - max_x p(x)k(d(x,g))]. Transcribed from this page in the current session and implemented in src/gemsdoe31/metric.py.
Submission: single-band float32 GeoTIFF at EPSG:32611 and 100 m, same bounds as the training data, values between 0 and 1, data outside the bounds null or nan.

Test truth: faults manually identified by experts that are NOT contained in the public USGS database; after the initial prize round an expert panel uses submitted predictions to update fault labels for the whole region and submissions are rescored.

Provided features: training_features.tif with 19 layers (conductivity/depth to conductive base, detrended elevation and its slope, strain rates, isostatic gravity anomaly and its slope, magnetics incl. rtp/tmi with vertical and horizontal slopes and top-of-crustal magnetic source depth, earthquake density) and 1m_DEM_links.csv.

Prize structure printed on this page: Initial Prize Round top 5 win $10,000 each; Final Prize Round pays $100,000 / $70,000 / $40,000 / $25,000 / $15,000; one submission is selected for scoring in both rounds.
An official reference solution exists: https://github.com/drivendataorg/gems-prize-reference-solution

The page says the provided sample submission 'predicts total fault absence'; the owner-mirror copy's non-zero cells are exactly the catalogue raster, which is recorded as IR-31-TEMPLATE-CATALOGUE-CONTENT rather than silently accepted.
sources.limits: Public/private leaderboard values were not accessed. The official data-download tab redirects to login in this environment.

sources.title: USGS FDSN Event Web Service / ComCat moment-tensor query
claims_verified: The official API documentation supports custom event queries and count requests.
A broad approximate-envelope query returned 618 event records with a moment-tensor product; an inspected event record lists focal-mechanism and moment-tensor product types.
sources.limits: The query rectangle is an approximate envelope, not the exact competition footprint. Count and one inspected record do not verify spatial distribution, solution quality, independent station coverage, data license for every product component, or holdout utility. No model was fit.

sources.title: ASTER L2 Surface Reflectance VNIR and SWIR V004 (AST_07.004)
claims_verified: NASA CMR describes AST_07.004 as ASTER VNIR/SWIR surface reflectance with 15 m VNIR and 30 m SWIR posting.
The approximate-bbox preflight returned at least one pre-2008 granule whose reported polygon intersects the broad query rectangle; linked SWIR assets use lp-prod-protected URLs.
CMR metadata notes ASTER SWIR detector failure on 2009-01-12 and warns about earlier anomaly periods.
sources.limits: No ASTER binary was downloaded, no Earthdata-authenticated access was available or tested, and one matching granule is not full-footprint coverage. The approximate rectangle is not the exact GEMS polygon.
